provenance_class.terrain_predictor: pre-outcome primary predictor; frozen in PAPER2_OUTCOME_BLIND_PREDICTOR_SET_V1
provenance_class.R_main_model: pre-outcome staged model; explicitly specified in PAPER2_REAL_OUTCOME_EXECUTION_V1
provenance_class.primary_penguin_counts: already opened for the A x H analysis
provenance_class.life_history_order: new secondary biological prediction frozen now, after A x H outcomes but before any R-main fit or gamma_R value is opened

question: Does frozen 2-km local topographic relief alter site coupling to shared species-wide demographic forcing, and is that terrain dependence ordered among Pygoscelis species as predicted from breeding-life-history sensitivity?

predictor.transform: z(log1p(field)) within each species primary analysis frame
predictor.coverage: 122/122 candidate sites have valid 2-km terrain support
predictor.ecological_boundary: relief is terrain heterogeneity, not a direct measurement of slope, wind exposure, snow-free ground or occupied nest microhabitat

primary_frame.rule: Use exactly the frozen V3 A/H predictor-complete units so terrain coefficients are directly comparable to existing Paper 2 fits.
primary_frame.forcing: species-wide latent forcing for all three species

constraints: mean residual loading deviation b_i = 0 within each frozen spatial block
species-wide mean loading remains anchored at 1
model.observation_model: identical frozen observation calibration and interval-variance treatment used by the real V3 fit
model.fit_order: fit R alone; do not condition on A, H or A:H in the primary R-main fit

inference.species_null: Within each species and frozen V3 spatial block, permute the complete scalar R value among site time series and refit the R-only hierarchical loading model.
inference.species_test: two-sided permutation p because the original pre-outcome terrain predictor did not freeze a signed gamma_R prediction
inference.multiplicity: Holm-adjust the three species-specific two-sided p-values

secondary_life_history_prediction.status: post-primary-outcome but pre-R-fit; biological secondary test
secondary_life_history_prediction.prediction: Terrain buffering is strongest in Adelie, intermediate in chinstrap, and weakest in gentoo: gamma_R_ADPE < gamma_R_CHPE < gamma_R_GEPE, with gamma_R_ADPE < 0.
secondary_life_history_prediction.support_requirement: observed ordered_score > 0 and upper-tail block-permutation p <= 0.05 using the same independent within-species block permutations as the species tests
secondary_life_history_prediction.wording_if_supported: species-ordered terrain dependence consistent with the life-history prediction
secondary_life_history_prediction.wording_if_failed: no support for a life-history ordering of terrain dependence

sensitivities.terrain_metric: replace 2-km relief with 2-km elevation SD; sensitivity only because r=0.99067 with relief
sensitivities.radius: 1 km and 5 km relief; sensitivity only and never replace 2 km primary
sensitivities.terrain_only_expanded_frame: where the frozen forcing/observation cohort and terrain are available, fit a terrain-only expanded frame as a coverage sensitivity; never replace the 41/34/29 primary frame
sensitivities.observation_source: exclude-unknown source sensitivity where recovered support permits

decision_boundaries: Do not call relief a snow-clearing mechanism without an independent snow/wind exposure analysis.
Do not use the already-observed A x H result to alter the terrain transform, radius, block structure or species order.
Do not select a subset of species after seeing gamma_R.
The pre-outcome R-main test and the newly frozen species-order test must be reported separately.
A terrain effect on loading is response filtering, not evidence that terrain changes mean population growth unless the separately staged mean-growth analysis supports that claim.
